assessment_summary:
Claim 1 (delta squared): Valid. Uses correspondence theorem correctly.
Claim 3 (clifford): Valid. Correctly evaluates walks modulo q+1.
Corollary 4 (exactness): Valid. Directly follows from clifford identity.
Lemma 5 (defin): Valid. Correctly uses dimensions to show subspace containment.
Proposition 7 (Cone Identity): Valid. Inductive step correctly uses \partial^2=0.
Observation 8 (adjointness): Valid.
Claim 9 (Bilinear duality): Valid logic (though typo in statement dimensions).
Corollary 10 (middle symmetry): Valid.
Theorem 11 (homologies vanish): Valid. Uses cones for t<k and duality for t>k.
Proposition 12 (small generators): INVALID. Line 0431 incorrectly applies the cone identity \partial c_W = W - c_{\partial W}, which strictly relies on \partial^2=0. Since this proposition operates over an arbitrary ring where \partial^2 \neq 0, the identity fails, and the proposed elements W - c_{\partial W} are not cycles.
Claim 13 (small-set-expansion): Valid. Applies inclusion-exclusion for intersections correctly.
Claim 14 (contraction): Valid.
Claim 15 (cone bound): Valid. Establishes correct recursive bound.
Theorem 16 (expansion): Valid. Bounds expansion via cone size and symmetry.
Claim 18 (two cones): Valid. Explicit construction works.
Observations 23/24, Corollary 25, Claim 26: Valid. Standard polar space arguments.
Proposition 28 & Claim 29 (partdom): Valid. Probabilistic method and Chernoff bounds used flawlessly.
